reauth_confirm.title: Authenticate with your ONU stick
reauth_confirm.description: Enter the username and password used on the ONU login page.

boa.title: Connect to the stock web interface
boa.description: Read the Device Status and PON Status pages. Enter the username and password used on the ONU login page. Leave credentials blank only for direct access. Enter the password again when reconfiguring.

ssh.title: Connect to ODI OSS over SSH
ssh.description: Enroll your dedicated public key on the stick and place its private key in xpon_onu_stick/ssh/ under the Home Assistant configuration directory. Verify the stick’s Ed25519 host fingerprint using a trusted connection.

data.sync_clock: Sync the stick clock with Home Assistant

ssh_reauth.title: Update the ODI OSS SSH key
ssh_reauth.description: Enroll the new public key on the stick and enter the private key filename from xpon_onu_stick/ssh/. Use Reconfigure to change the address or host fingerprint.

error.cannot_connect: Could not read both status pages. Check the address and that Home Assistant can reach the ONU management network.
error.invalid_auth: The ONU rejected authentication or returned an unsupported login page. Check the username and password used on the device's login page.
error.invalid_host: Enter a hostname, IP address, or HTTP(S) base URL without a path, query, or embedded credentials.
error.unsupported_device: The pages do not contain the expected Device Status and PON Status fields, or a value is invalid.
error.username_required: A username is required when a password is provided.
error.session_busy: The ONU already has an active management session. Sign out of the other session and try again.
error.invalid_ssh_host: Enter the stick’s hostname or IP address. Enter the port separately.
error.invalid_ssh_port: Enter an SSH port from 1 to 65535.
error.invalid_ssh_fingerprint: Enter the verified OpenSSH SHA-256 host fingerprint, including the SHA256: prefix.
error.invalid_ssh_key_file: Could not load the key. Use the filename of an unencrypted Ed25519 private key with mode 0600 in xpon_onu_stick/ssh/.
error.ssh_host_key_mismatch: The stick’s SSH host key does not match the fingerprint. Verify the host key before changing the fingerprint.
error.ssh_key_rejected: The stick rejected the private key. Check that its matching public key is enrolled on the stick.
error.cannot_connect_ssh: Could not read status over SSH. Check the address, port, and reachability from Home Assistant.
error.unsupported_ssh_device: The SSH reply did not contain the expected ODI OSS build, GPON status, and management MAC.

abort.already_configured: This ONU stick is already configured.
abort.unique_id_mismatch: This address belongs to a different ONU stick. Add it as a separate integration.

session.title: Session settings
session.description: Disabled by default. When enabled, close a login opened by this integration after reading status. Existing sessions are left open.

data.logout_after_poll: Log out after a successful poll

polling.title: Refresh interval
polling.description: Refresh every 10 to 3600 seconds. The default is 30 seconds. This changes only Home Assistant polling.

status_limits.title: Status limits
status_limits.description: Optical limits use GPON Class B+ defaults. Temperature and voltage use generic SFP guidelines. Adjust these advisory limits for your module. Set both bias current limits from its specification or leave both blank. This changes only Home Assistant status labels.

clock.title: Clock synchronization
clock.description: Enabled by default. Home Assistant corrects the ODI OSS system clock when it differs by more than one minute.

data.sync_clock: Sync the stick clock with Home Assistant

error.invalid_limit: Enter a finite number for this limit.
error.invalid_range: The maximum must be greater than the minimum.
error.negative_limit: Voltage and bias current limits cannot be negative.
error.invalid_temperature_warning: The warm threshold must be at least the minimum and below the high threshold.
error.invalid_rx_margin: Use a nonnegative margin smaller than half the receive power range.
error.bias_limits_required: Set both minimum and maximum bias current or leave both blank.
